primary_success: rotation<2deg AND translation<0.5m; no ICP or 4DOF
scope: same ETH forest; new seeds do not establish cross-forest generalization
paper_comparability: paper does not specify success threshold or unambiguously identify ETH pair list; report all15 and official10 separately
ground_truth: diagnosis and evaluation only; inference may never use it

recovery_constants.geometry: enumerate bounded evidence triples; full6DOF Kabsch; no iterative nearest-neighbour refinement or GT inference

selection: maximum successes of svd+ransac on all150 old-seed cases; ties prefer earlier simpler candidate; use baseline if no improvement; then freeze once before extracting reserved seeds21-30
